gullshore_pm: Hi team — Gullshore wants to onboard a multimodal returns assistant (images of labels/receipts + short text) trained on 40k return cases. Big constraint: our legal & procurement require an air-gapped, on-prem deployment. No cloud object storage for model or eval data. Can Redwood support on-prem ingestion and private runtime with HSM and removable-media model install? Go-live target: 3 weeks.

 tanya_cs: Thanks @gullshore_pm. On-prem air-gapped is supported but it's a different onboarding flow. Need clarification: 1) do you require Redwood to ship an appliance, or will you install our Private package? 2) Will you accept an ONNX/int8 quantized model for performance? 3) Acceptance tests — will you provide a sanitized eval set via physical media? cc @hugo_infra and @saira_security.

 gullshore_pm: We will host and install the Private package in our secure facility. We can accept int8 ONNX. We'll provide a sanitized eval set on an encrypted hard drive and a signed manifest. Legal insists on HSM for key signing and that logs never leave the facility. Deterministic outputs for dispute cases required.

 hugo_infra: Ops notes: on-prem workflow supported. We'll need an install window for the Private runtime and HSM key provisioning instructions. For A100-class performance with int8, plan for 1-2 GPU nodes. Also: we'll run local canary by routing 5% of traffic to the new node and validate acceptance. Can you confirm target p95 and throughput?

 gullshore_pm: p95 <= 240ms for 512 tokens, baseline throughput 60 qps. Renewal sensitivity: HIGH if we fail latency or any data-exfil incident.

 saira_security: Security: require a written runbook for physical media handling, checksum verification, and HSM key ops. Also we must see a redaction hook that masks OCR-extracted PII (IDs, phone numbers). Proof of zero leakage during pre-prod demo required. Please confirm retention TTL for audit proofs.

 tanya_cs: Understood. Immediate asks: 1) customer to ship encrypted drive + signed manifest to Redwood SOC (or to their datacenter if they prefer internal install). 2) provide model artifact in ONNX int8 + tokenizer + model_spec on media. 3) provide a 300-sample sanitized acceptance set + 100 adversarial PII probes on the same media. 4) consent form for on-prem install and entitlements.

 gullshore_pm: We'll ship to our site and install internal staff will hand to Redwood engineer under supervised transfer. We'll include manifest and consent form. Retention TTL for audit proofs: 1 year (in local storage only).

 hugo_infra: Plan from infra: create an on-prem deployment runbook, schedule install window (TBD), provision Private runtime license, and generate an HSM key material template for the DPO. For canary: local 5% -> 25% -> 100% with rollback switch. We'll need a test harness that can run locally (we'll provide a Dockerized Redwood Optimize runner).

 saira_security: Eval/QA requirements: 1) run local PII residual scan pre- and post-redaction; 2) demonstrate deterministic mode and logprob toggles; 3) HSM-signed audit proofs for each accepted request; 4) show that audit proofs contain only metadata (hashes, timestamps), no plaintext PII. If any residual PII found, onboarding halts.

 tanya_cs: @hugo_infra @saira_security I'll open a ticket for on-prem intake and schedule an enablement/demo call. @gullshore_pm please share preferred install weeks and shipping ETA for media. I'll also prepare an acceptance checklist for the demo.

 gullshore_pm: Shipping ETA: encrypted drive + manifest next Wed (physical handoff). Install week: two weeks after shipping is fine. We'll include the sanitized set and adversarial probes.

 deploy-bot: Ticket CS-9988 created: "Gullshore multimodal returns assistant  on-prem air-gapped intake"  assignees: tanya_cs, hugo_infra, saira_security. Provisioning window estimate: 2026-04-15..2026-04-29.

 tanya_cs: Thanks all. For evals @hugo_infra will coordinate the local Redwood Optimize runner; @saira_security will validate PII residuals. We'll demo redaction + signed-audit flow in the enablement call. Renewal risk: marked HIGH until post-canary and zero residuals confirmed.

 gullshore_pm: Appreciate the fast help. One more legal ask: can we see a sample HSM-signed proof format before shipping?

 saira_security: We'll attach a template in the ticket (hash-only proof with signature + metadata). We'll also provide the physical transfer checklist.

 tanya_cs: Enablement invite pending — tentatively next Fri 10am local (install site timezone). Closing loop here; will update ticket with runbook and checklist.
